FROM: Director of Counter-Intelligence
TO: Chief, Satellite Recovery Division
SUBJECT: Debriefing - Agent NIGHTINGALE

Agent NIGHTINGALE has successfully located the debris field from
the classified Sputnik-2B launch. The crash site was confirmed at
coordinates 54.2861° N, 48.2269° E (Ulyanovsk sector, USSR).

The satellite's secret payload - a coded message - was believed lost.
However, we have reason to believe NIGHTINGALE recovered fragments
and may have hidden them in plain sight across modern communication
channels before going dark.

Your mission is to trace these digital breadcrumbs. Agent NIGHTINGALE
was known to use the handle "@nightingale_reborn" on certain platforms.

The password for all relevant materials is: echoes_of_sputnik

The package must be recovered. The cipher must be broken.

- END BRIEFING -
